text:
emma-partnerships: Quick heads-up — CipherGrid marketplace listing is targeting a soft launch on Apr 22. We need a full dry-run for SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM key-byok flow this week. Who can own the runbook and the post-dryrun rollback plan? :spiral_calendar:

liam-eng-security: I can take SSO/SAML and SCIM security checks. Need the partner IdP metadata and a service account for SCIM sandbox. Also: confirm SCIM supports group->role mapping (we use role attribute mapping currently).

raj-infra: For KMS: CipherGrid wants BYOK via PKCS#11 and optional cloud-KMS wrap. We support both but need to validate our connector cert chain and HSM client version. I'll spin up a staging HSM and run the PKCS#11 test. Estimated 2-3 hours.

marta-solutions: I'll own the test plan + acceptance criteria. Draft checklist below — please add items or emoji reactions.
- verify SSO SAML login + idp-initiated flows
- SCIM: create/update/deprovision user, group sync, role mapping test
- KMS: import wrapped key, sign/unwrap sample token, rotate key + verify services failover to hosted key
- secrets manager: secret retrieval latency and permission scoping tests
- telemetry: track auth latencies, 401s/403s, SCIM delta failures
- rollback: revoke partner certs and revert to hosted keys

omlivia-sales: Heads up — partner wants press embargo lifted one week after soft launch. Marketing needs a firm dry-run date to schedule screenshots + quotes. Can we commit to this Friday?

sophie-legal: Quick checklist for me: DPA in place, audit questionnaires answered, any cross-border data flow? also confirm HSM attestation for compliance (FIPS/CC if requested). If partner requires additional terms, loop me in.

liam-eng-security: @emma-partnerships please add partner IdP SAML metadata and SCIM base URL. Also run this SCIM smoke locally before we hit staging: ```bash
curl -u scim-svc:REDACTED -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -X POST https://staging-ciphergrid.example.com/scim/v2/Users 
  -d '{"userName":"dryrun.user","name":{"givenName":"Dry","familyName":"Run"}}'
```

raj-infra: deploy-bot created staging cluster: marketplace-staging-2026. Deployed KMS connector v1.8.2 and scim-proxy v0.9.4. Use creds in 1password (partnerships/staging/ciphergrid).

deploy-bot: Deployed marketplace-staging-2026 -> services: scim-proxy, sso-mock, kms-connector. Health checks passing (3/3). :white_check_mark:

emma-partnerships: Plan: dry-run Fri 10:00 PT. Liam + Raj + Marta on the call. Olivia/Marketing — stand by for screenshots after 10:45. Sophie-legal — can you confirm DPA sign-off by EOD Thu? If anything blocks, escalate here.

marta-solutions: I'll publish the runbook in Confluence and ping everyone. Adding post-run metrics to Redwood Console alerts (SCIM error rate, SAML latency, KMS unwrap errors).

liam-eng-security: One more: enable strict audience check on SAML in staging. Partner to confirm SP entityID.

emma-partnerships: Excellent. Thanks team — i'll create calendar invite and attach runbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
